chapter_ids.description: 章节 ID（逗号分隔，scope=chapter时使用）

nodes.name: 参数接收
nodes.expression: (function() { const audit_id = 'AUDIT-' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10).replace(/-/g,'') + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6).toUpperCase(); const audit_dir = 'workflows/project/logs/audits/' + audit_id; return { audit_id, audit_dir, scope: inputs.audit_scope, started_at: new Date().toISOString(), period: { start: new Date(Date.now() - inputs.period_days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString().slice(0, 10), end: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) } }; })()

nodes.name: 扫描待审查项
nodes.description: 扫描所有待审查的任务和文档
nodes.command: echo '=== 扫描待审查项 ===' && mkdir -p workflows/project/logs/reviews && echo "TASKPACKS_COUNT=$(find design/ai-native/03_taskpacks -name '*.md' -mtime -${inputs.period_days} 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" && echo 'TASKPACKS_SAMPLE_BEGIN' && find design/ai-native/03_taskpacks -name '*.md' -mtime -${inputs.period_days} 2>/dev/null | sort | head -20 && echo 'TASKPACKS_SAMPLE_END' && echo "SPECS_COUNT=$(find design/ai-native/02_specs -name '*.md' -mtime -${inputs.period_days} 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" && echo 'SPECS_SAMPLE_BEGIN' && find design/ai-native/02_specs -name '*.md' -mtime -${inputs.period_days} 2>/dev/null | sort | head -20 && echo 'SPECS_SAMPLE_END' && echo "COMMITS_COUNT=$(git log --oneline --since='${inputs.period_days} days ago' 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" && echo 'COMMITS_SAMPLE_BEGIN' && git log --oneline --since='${inputs.period_days} days ago' 2>/dev/null | head -20 && echo 'COMMITS_SAMPLE_END' && echo "REVIEWS_COUNT=$(find workflows/project/logs/reviews -name '*.json' -mtime -${inputs.period_days} 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" && echo 'REVIEWS_SAMPLE_BEGIN' && find workflows/project/logs/reviews -name '*.json' -mtime -${inputs.period_days} 2>/dev/null | sort | head -20 && echo 'REVIEWS_SAMPLE_END'

nodes.name: 解析扫描结果
nodes.expression: (function() { const output = nodes.scan_pending_items.output.stdout || ''; const getInt = (key) => { const m = output.match(new RegExp('^' + key + '=(\\d+)\\s*$', 'm')); return m ? parseInt(m[1], 10) : 0; }; const getBlock = (start, end) => { const re = new RegExp(start + '\\n([\\s\\S]*?)\\n' + end); const m = output.match(re); if (!m) return []; return m[1].split('\\n').map(l => l.trim()).filter(Boolean); }; const taskpacks = getInt('TASKPACKS_COUNT'); const specs = getInt('SPECS_COUNT'); const commits = getInt('COMMITS_COUNT'); const reviews = getInt('REVIEWS_COUNT'); const samples = { taskpacks: getBlock('TASKPACKS_SAMPLE_BEGIN', 'TASKPACKS_SAMPLE_END'), specs: getBlock('SPECS_SAMPLE_BEGIN', 'SPECS_SAMPLE_END'), commits: getBlock('COMMITS_SAMPLE_BEGIN', 'COMMITS_SAMPLE_END'), reviews: getBlock('REVIEWS_SAMPLE_BEGIN', 'REVIEWS_SAMPLE_END') }; return { pending: { taskpacks, specs, commits }, existing_reviews: reviews, samples, needs_code_review: commits > reviews, needs_design_review: specs > 0, needs_qa_signoff: taskpacks > 0 }; })()

nodes.description: 从 Bible/Spec 文档中解析结构化工作项清单

nodes.description: 自动触发缺失的审查流程（Code/Design/QA），并等待完成后继续汇总

nodes.name: 收集现有审查记录
nodes.command: mkdir -p workflows/project/logs/reviews && find workflows/project/logs/reviews -name '*.json' -type f -mtime -${inputs.period_days} 2>/dev/null | sort | while read f; do [ -f "$f" ] && cat "$f" && echo '|||'; done | head -50000

nodes.name: 汇总审查数据
nodes.expression: (function() { const output = nodes.collect_existing_reviews.output.stdout || ''; const parts = output.split('|||').filter(p => p.trim()); const raw = []; parts.forEach(p => { try { const obj = JSON.parse(p.trim()); if (obj && (obj.review_id || obj.signoff_id || obj.acceptance_id)) { raw.push(obj); } } catch(e) {} }); const includeCode = inputs.include_code_review !== false; const includeDesign = inputs.include_design_review !== false; const includeQa = inputs.include_qa_signoff !== false; const included = raw.filter(r => { const isCode = r.review_id && r.review_id.startsWith('CR-'); const isDesign = r.review_id && r.review_id.startsWith('DR-'); const isQa = r.signoff_id && r.signoff_id.startsWith('QA-'); return (includeCode && isCode) || (includeDesign && isDesign) || (includeQa && isQa); }); const crs = included.filter(r => r.review_id && r.review_id.startsWith('CR-')); const drs = included.filter(r => r.review_id && r.review_id.startsWith('DR-')); const qas = included.filter(r => r.signoff_id && r.signoff_id.startsWith('QA-')); return { include: { code_review: includeCode, design_review: includeDesign, qa_signoff: includeQa }, code_reviews: { count: crs.length, passed: crs.filter(r => r.result === 'APPROVED').length, avg_score: crs.length > 0 ? Math.round(crs.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.score || 0), 0) / crs.length) : 0 }, design_reviews: { count: drs.length, passed: drs.filter(r => r.result === 'APPROVED').length, avg_score: drs.length > 0 ? Math.round(drs.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.score || 0), 0) / drs.length) : 0 }, qa_signoffs: { count: qas.length, passed: qas.filter(r => r.result === 'PASSED' || r.result === 'PARTIAL').length }, all_reviews: included, all_reviews_raw: raw, included_count: included.length, raw_count: raw.length }; })()

nodes.name: AI 代码审查
nodes.description: 使用 cursor-agent 进行智能代码审查分析
nodes.command: if [ '${inputs.include_code_review}' = 'true' ]; then node workflows/project/tools/review-system/ai-code-review.mjs --project-root='${inputs.project_root}' --commit-range='HEAD~${inputs.period_days}..HEAD' --task-id='${nodes.intake.output.audit_id}-CODE' --output='${nodes.intake.output.audit_dir}/code-review.json' 2>&1 || echo '{"review_id":"SKIP","result":"FAILED","reason":"AI analysis error"}'; else echo '{"review_id":"SKIP","result":"SKIPPED","reason":"AI code review disabled"}'; fi

nodes.name: AI 设计审查
nodes.description: 使用 cursor-agent 进行智能设计文档审查
nodes.command: if [ '${inputs.include_design_review}' = 'true' ]; then SPEC_FILE=$(find design/ai-native/02_specs -name '*.md' -type f 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$SPEC_FILE" ]; then node workflows/project/tools/review-system/ai-design-review.mjs --project-root='${inputs.project_root}' --doc-path="$SPEC_FILE" --task-id='${nodes.intake.output.audit_id}-DESIGN' --output='${nodes.intake.output.audit_dir}/design-review.json' 2>&1 || echo '{"review_id":"SKIP","result":"FAILED","reason":"AI analysis error"}'; else echo '{"review_id":"SKIP","result":"SKIPPED","reason":"No spec files found"}'; fi; else echo '{"review_id":"SKIP","result":"SKIPPED","reason":"AI design review disabled"}'; fi

nodes.name: 合并 AI 审查结果
nodes.description: 将 AI 审查结果合并到汇总数据中
nodes.expression: (function() { const agg = nodes.aggregate_reviews.output; const aiCodeRaw = nodes.ai_code_review?.output?.stdout || '{}'; const aiDesignRaw = nodes.ai_design_review?.output?.stdout || '{}'; let aiCode = {}; let aiDesign = {}; try { aiCode = JSON.parse(aiCodeRaw.trim().split('\n').pop() || '{}'); } catch(e) { aiCode = { result: 'PARSE_ERROR' }; } try { aiDesign = JSON.parse(aiDesignRaw.trim().split('\n').pop() || '{}'); } catch(e) { aiDesign = { result: 'PARSE_ERROR' }; } const mergedReviews = [...(agg.all_reviews || [])]; if (aiCode.review_id && aiCode.result !== 'SKIPPED') { mergedReviews.push(aiCode); } if (aiDesign.review_id && aiDesign.result !== 'SKIPPED') { mergedReviews.push(aiDesign); } const crs = mergedReviews.filter(r => r.review_id && r.review_id.includes('CODE')); const drs = mergedReviews.filter(r => r.review_id && r.review_id.includes('DESIGN')); return { ...agg, ai_code_review: aiCode, ai_design_review: aiDesign, code_reviews: { count: crs.length, passed: crs.filter(r => r.result === 'APPROVED').length, avg_score: crs.length > 0 ? Math.round(crs.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.score || 0), 0) / crs.length) : agg.code_reviews.avg_score }, design_reviews: { count: drs.length, passed: drs.filter(r => r.result === 'APPROVED').length, avg_score: drs.length > 0 ? Math.round(drs.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.score || 0), 0) / drs.length) : agg.design_reviews.avg_score }, all_reviews: mergedReviews, has_ai_analysis: (aiCode.result && aiCode.result !== 'SKIPPED') || (aiDesign.result && aiDesign.result !== 'SKIPPED') }; })()

nodes.name: 解析工作项清单
nodes.description: 从需求解析器输出中提取工作项
nodes.expression: (function() { try { const stdout = nodes.parse_requirements?.output?.stdout || '{}'; const parsed = JSON.parse(stdout); return { ok: parsed.ok !== false, items: parsed.items || [], summary: parsed.summary || {}, warnings: parsed.warnings || [] }; } catch(e) { return { ok: false, items: [], summary: {}, warnings: ['JSON parse error: ' + e.message] }; } })()

nodes.name: 计算多维度进度
nodes.description: 按模块、章节、系统、优先级统计完成度
nodes.expression: (function() { const items = nodes.parse_work_items.output.items || []; const modules = ['narrative', 'system', 'ui', 'level', 'art', 'qa', 'infra', 'other']; const chapters = ['C0', 'C1', 'C2', 'C3', 'C4', 'C5', 'common']; const priorities = ['P0', 'P1', 'P2']; const initStat = () => ({ total: 0, done: 0, in_progress: 0, blocked: 0, pct: '0%' }); const breakdown = { overall: initStat(), by_module: {}, by_chapter: {}, by_priority: {} }; modules.forEach(m => breakdown.by_module[m] = initStat()); chapters.forEach(c => breakdown.by_chapter[c] = initStat()); priorities.forEach(p => breakdown.by_priority[p] = initStat()); items.forEach(item => { breakdown.overall.total++; if (item.status === 'done') breakdown.overall.done++; else if (item.status === 'in_progress') breakdown.overall.in_progress++; else if (item.status === 'blocked') breakdown.overall.blocked++; const mod = item.module || 'other'; if (breakdown.by_module[mod]) { breakdown.by_module[mod].total++; if (item.status === 'done') breakdown.by_module[mod].done++; else if (item.status === 'in_progress') breakdown.by_module[mod].in_progress++; else if (item.status === 'blocked') breakdown.by_module[mod].blocked++; } const chap = item.chapter || 'common'; if (breakdown.by_chapter[chap]) { breakdown.by_chapter[chap].total++; if (item.status === 'done') breakdown.by_chapter[chap].done++; else if (item.status === 'in_progress') breakdown.by_chapter[chap].in_progress++; else if (item.status === 'blocked') breakdown.by_chapter[chap].blocked++; } const pri = item.priority || 'P1'; if (breakdown.by_priority[pri]) { breakdown.by_priority[pri].total++; if (item.status === 'done') breakdown.by_priority[pri].done++; else if (item.status === 'in_progress') breakdown.by_priority[pri].in_progress++; else if (item.status === 'blocked') breakdown.by_priority[pri].blocked++; } }); const calcPct = (s) => { if (s.total === 0) return; const pct = Math.round((s.done / s.total) * 100); s.pct = pct + '%'; const filled = Math.round(pct / 10); s.bar = '[' + '='.repeat(filled) + '-'.repeat(10 - filled) + ']'; }; calcPct(breakdown.overall); Object.values(breakdown.by_module).forEach(calcPct); Object.values(breakdown.by_chapter).forEach(calcPct); Object.values(breakdown.by_priority).forEach(calcPct); return breakdown; })()

nodes.name: 计算细化评分
nodes.description: 基于完成度和门禁结果计算各维度评分
nodes.expression: (function() { const breakdown = nodes.calculate_progress_breakdown.output; const agg = nodes.merge_ai_reviews?.output || nodes.aggregate_reviews.output; const scan = nodes.parse_scan_results.output; const scores = []; const deductions = []; let totalScore = 0; const weights = { completeness: 0.3, code_quality: 0.25, test_coverage: 0.2, doc_sync: 0.15, security: 0.1 }; const overallPct = parseInt(breakdown.overall.pct, 10) || 0; let completenessScore = 100; if (overallPct < 50) { const d = Math.round((50 - overallPct) * 0.5); completenessScore -= d; deductions.push({ dimension: '完整性', reason: '总体完成度过低 (' + overallPct + '%)', points: d, severity: 'major' }); } const p0 = breakdown.by_priority.P0 || { total: 0, done: 0 }; if (p0.total > 0 && p0.done < p0.total) { const d = Math.round((1 - p0.done / p0.total) * 30); completenessScore -= d; deductions.push({ dimension: '完整性', reason: 'P0任务未全部完成 (' + p0.done + '/' + p0.total + ')', points: d, severity: 'blocker' }); } if (breakdown.overall.blocked > 0) { const d = Math.min(breakdown.overall.blocked * 5, 20); completenessScore -= d; deductions.push({ dimension: '完整性', reason: '存在' + breakdown.overall.blocked + '个阻塞任务', points: d, severity: 'blocker' }); } scores.push({ dimension: 'completeness', dimension_name: '完整性', weight: weights.completeness, score: Math.max(0, completenessScore), max_score: 100, weighted_score: Math.max(0, completenessScore) * weights.completeness, deductions: deductions.filter(d => d.dimension === '完整性') }); let codeQualityScore = 85; if (agg.code_reviews.count === 0 && scan.pending.commits > 10) { codeQualityScore -= 15; deductions.push({ dimension: '代码规范性', reason: '无代码审查记录', points: 15, severity: 'major' }); } else if (agg.code_reviews.avg_score > 0 && agg.code_reviews.avg_score < 70) { const d = Math.round((70 - agg.code_reviews.avg_score) * 0.3); codeQualityScore -= d; deductions.push({ dimension: '代码规范性', reason: '代码审查均分较低 (' + agg.code_reviews.avg_score + ')', points: d, severity: 'minor' }); } scores.push({ dimension: 'code_quality', dimension_name: '代码规范性', weight: weights.code_quality, score: Math.max(0, codeQualityScore), max_score: 100, weighted_score: Math.max(0, codeQualityScore) * weights.code_quality, deductions: deductions.filter(d => d.dimension === '代码规范性') }); let testScore = 80; if (agg.qa_signoffs.count === 0) { testScore -= 20; deductions.push({ dimension: '测试覆盖', reason: '无QA签字记录', points: 20, severity: 'major' }); } scores.push({ dimension: 'test_coverage', dimension_name: '测试覆盖', weight: weights.test_coverage, score: Math.max(0, testScore), max_score: 100, weighted_score: Math.max(0, testScore) * weights.test_coverage, deductions: deductions.filter(d => d.dimension === '测试覆盖') }); let docScore = 85; if (agg.design_reviews.count === 0 && scan.pending.specs > 0) { docScore -= 15; deductions.push({ dimension: '文档同步', reason: '无设计审查记录', points: 15, severity: 'minor' }); } scores.push({ dimension: 'doc_sync', dimension_name: '文档同步', weight: weights.doc_sync, score: Math.max(0, docScore), max_score: 100, weighted_score: Math.max(0, docScore) * weights.doc_sync, deductions: deductions.filter(d => d.dimension === '文档同步') }); scores.push({ dimension: 'security', dimension_name: '安全性', weight: weights.security, score: 90, max_score: 100, weighted_score: 90 * weights.security, deductions: [] }); totalScore = Math.round(scores.reduce((s, d) => s + d.weighted_score, 0)); let grade = 'F'; if (totalScore >= 90) grade = 'A'; else if (totalScore >= 80) grade = 'B'; else if (totalScore >= 70) grade = 'C'; else if (totalScore >= 60) grade = 'D'; return { total_score: totalScore, grade, score_details: scores, all_deductions: deductions, summary: { blockers: deductions.filter(d => d.severity === 'blocker').length, majors: deductions.filter(d => d.severity === 'major').length, minors: deductions.filter(d => d.severity === 'minor').length } }; })()

nodes.name: 收集问题清单
nodes.expression: (function() { const reviews = nodes.aggregate_reviews.output.all_reviews || []; const blockers = []; const warnings = []; const improvements = []; reviews.forEach(r => { if (r.result === 'REJECTED' || r.result === 'FAILED') { blockers.push({ source: r.review_id || r.signoff_id, target: r.task_id || r.doc_path, issues: r.issues || r.blocking_issues || [] }); } else if (r.result === 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' || r.result === 'REVISION_REQUIRED') { warnings.push({ source: r.review_id || r.signoff_id, target: r.task_id || r.doc_path, issues: r.issues || [] }); } if (r.suggestions) { improvements.push(...r.suggestions); } }); return { blockers, warnings, improvements: [...new Set(improvements)], blocker_count: blockers.length, warning_count: warnings.length }; })()

nodes.name: 生成进度报告
nodes.expression: (function() { const agg = nodes.aggregate_reviews.output; const scan = nodes.parse_scan_results.output; const totalReviews = agg.code_reviews.count + agg.design_reviews.count + agg.qa_signoffs.count; const passedReviews = agg.code_reviews.passed + agg.design_reviews.passed + agg.qa_signoffs.passed; const overallRate = totalReviews > 0 ? Math.round((passedReviews / totalReviews) * 100) : 100; return { type: 'progress', audit_id: nodes.intake.output.audit_id, period: nodes.intake.output.period, metrics: { tasks_in_period: scan.pending.taskpacks, specs_in_period: scan.pending.specs, commits_in_period: scan.pending.commits, reviews_completed: totalReviews, reviews_passed: passedReviews, overall_pass_rate: overallRate + '%', code_review_avg_score: agg.code_reviews.avg_score, design_review_avg_score: agg.design_reviews.avg_score }, breakdown: { code_review: agg.code_reviews, design_review: agg.design_reviews, qa_signoff: agg.qa_signoffs }, status: overallRate >= 80 ? 'HEALTHY' : (overallRate >= 60 ? 'WARNING' : 'CRITICAL') }; })()

nodes.name: 生成问题报告
nodes.expression: ({ type: 'issues', audit_id: nodes.intake.output.audit_id, period: nodes.intake.output.period, summary: { blocker_count: nodes.collect_issues.output.blocker_count, warning_count: nodes.collect_issues.output.warning_count, improvement_count: nodes.collect_issues.output.improvements.length }, blockers: nodes.collect_issues.output.blockers, warnings: nodes.collect_issues.output.warnings, improvements: nodes.collect_issues.output.improvements, priority_actions: nodes.collect_issues.output.blocker_count > 0 ? ['优先解决阻塞问题'] : (nodes.collect_issues.output.warning_count > 0 ? ['处理警告问题'] : ['维持现状']) })

nodes.name: 生成决策建议
nodes.expression: (function() { const progress = nodes.generate_progress_report.output; const issues = nodes.generate_issue_report.output; const scan = nodes.parse_scan_results.output; const include = nodes.aggregate_reviews.output.include || { code_review: true, design_review: true, qa_signoff: true }; const recommendations = []; if (issues.summary.blocker_count > 0) { recommendations.push('🔴 存在 ' + issues.summary.blocker_count + ' 个阻塞问题，建议暂停新开发，优先修复'); } if (issues.summary.warning_count > 5) { recommendations.push('🟡 警告问题较多（' + issues.summary.warning_count + '个），建议安排专项修复'); } if (include.code_review && progress.breakdown.code_review.count > 0 && progress.metrics.code_review_avg_score < 70) { recommendations.push('⚠️ 代码审查平均分较低（' + progress.metrics.code_review_avg_score + '），建议加强代码规范培训'); } if (include.code_review && progress.breakdown.code_review.count === 0 && scan.pending.commits > 0) { recommendations.push('⚠️ 本周期无代码审查记录，建议补充 Code Review'); } if (include.design_review && progress.breakdown.design_review.count === 0 && scan.pending.specs > 0) { recommendations.push('⚠️ 本周期无设计审查记录，建议补充 Design Review'); } if (include.qa_signoff && progress.breakdown.qa_signoff.count === 0 && scan.pending.taskpacks > 0) { recommendations.push('⚠️ 本周期无 QA 签字记录，建议补充 QA Signoff'); } if (progress.status === 'HEALTHY') { recommendations.push('✅ 整体健康，可以继续推进'); } const nextSteps = []; if (issues.summary.blocker_count > 0) { nextSteps.push('修复阻塞问题'); } if (include.code_review && progress.breakdown.code_review.count === 0 && scan.pending.commits > 0) { nextSteps.push('补充缺失的代码审查'); } if (include.design_review && progress.breakdown.design_review.count === 0 && scan.pending.specs > 0) { nextSteps.push('补充缺失的设计审查'); } if (include.qa_signoff && progress.breakdown.qa_signoff.count === 0 && scan.pending.taskpacks > 0) { nextSteps.push('补充缺失的 QA 签字'); } nextSteps.push('定期复查进度'); return { decision: progress.status === 'HEALTHY' ? 'PROCEED' : (progress.status === 'WARNING' ? 'PROCEED_WITH_CAUTION' : 'HOLD'), recommendations, next_steps: nextSteps }; })()

nodes.name: 汇总最终报告（细化版）
nodes.expression: ({ audit_id: nodes.intake.output.audit_id, scope: inputs.audit_scope, requester: inputs.requester, period: nodes.intake.output.period, report_version: '2.0.0', scan_summary: nodes.parse_scan_results.output, progress: nodes.calculate_progress_breakdown.output, work_items: nodes.parse_work_items.output.items, work_items_summary: { total: (nodes.parse_work_items.output.items || []).length, by_status: nodes.parse_work_items.output.summary?.by_status || {}, by_source: nodes.parse_work_items.output.summary?.by_source || {} }, total_score: nodes.calculate_dimension_scores.output.total_score, score_grade: nodes.calculate_dimension_scores.output.grade, score_details: nodes.calculate_dimension_scores.output.score_details, progress_report: nodes.generate_progress_report.output, issue_report: nodes.generate_issue_report.output, recommendations: nodes.generate_recommendations.output, completed_at: new Date().toISOString() })

nodes.name: 构建进度报告 Markdown（细化版）
nodes.expression:
